name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context and the conversation. It assesses whether the response is on-topic and directly addresses points raised in the conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the response. A coherent response should make sense and be easily understood without confusion or ambiguity.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how engaging or interesting the response is. An engaging response is likely to prompt further conversation or interest from the other party.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response. A creative response might include unique insights, humor, or interesting facts that add value to the conversation.

name: Consistency
description: Assesses whether the response is consistent with the given context and any facts or information provided. Consistency ensures that there are no contradictions or errors in the response.
